title: Kenya’s Ngetich breaks women-only half-marathon world record by a second
english: Kenyan athlete Agnes Ngetich set a new world record for the women-only half-marathon in Copenhagen, finishing with a time of one hour, five minutes, and 15 seconds. She beat the previous record by one second and finished 50 seconds ahead of her fellow Kenyan competitor, Veronica Loleo. This achievement adds to an impressive year for the 25-year-old runner, who has already secured victories in the World Cross Country Championships and team events.
amharic: የኬንያዊቷ አትሌት አግነስ ንጌቲች በኮፐንሃገን በተካሄደው የሴቶች ብቻ ግማሽ ማራቶን ውድድር በአንድ ሰዓት ከአምስት ደቂቃ ከ15 ሰከንድ በመጨረስ አዲስ የዓለም ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግባለች። ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን ክብረ ወሰን በአንድ ሰከንድ ያሻሻለችው ንጌቲች፣ ሁለተኛ የወጣችውን አገሯን ቬሮኒካ ሎሌኦን በ50 ሰከንድ ቀድማለች። ይህ ድል በአመቱ የዓለም የጎዳና ላይ ሩጫ ውድድር እና የዓለም የክርሮስ ካንትሪ ሻምፒዮናን ጨምሮ በርካታ ድሎችን ያስመዘገበችው የ25 ዓመቷ አትሌት የላቀ ብቃት ማሳያ ነው።
oromo: Atileetiin Keeniyaa Agnes Ngetich sagantaa fiigicha walakkaa maaraatoonii dubartoota qofa irratti Kopenheeganitti gaggeeffame irratti sa’aatii tokko, daqiiqaa shan fi sekondii 15 keessatti xumuruun riikardii addunyaa haaraa galteetti. Ngetich riikardii kanaan dura ture sekondii tokkoon kan fooyyessite yoo ta’u, dorgomtuu ishee biyya ishee Keeniyaa irraa taate Veroniikaa Loleoo sekondii 50 dura buuteetti. Injifannoon kun atleetii umuriin ishee 25 ta’e kanaaf, bara kana keessa Shaampiyoonaa Ardii fi fiigicha addunyaa irratti milkaa’ina gurguddaa argatteef dabalee kan itti dabalame dha.

title: Trump says his planned triumphal arch will double as a military complex to store ammunition
english: President Trump has announced updated plans for his proposed 250-foot triumphal arch to serve as a high-tech military facility. He claims the structure will house ammunition and provide tactical capabilities for deploying snipers and drones for national security. While construction is intended to start near Arlington, official details regarding approvals and timelines remain unclear.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ሊገነቡት ያቀዱት 250 ጫማ ከፍታ ያለው ድል አድራጊ ቅስት (triumphal arch) የወታደራዊ መሣሪያዎች ማከማቻ ሆኖ እንዲያገለግል ማሻሻያ ማድረጋቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ሕንፃ ጥይቶችን ከመያዙም በላይ ለስናይፐሮች እና ድሮኖች መጠቀሚያነት የሚያገለግል የወታደራዊ ደህንነት ማዕከል እንደሚሆን ገልጸዋል። የፕሮጀክቱ ግንባታ ከአርሊንግተን አጠገብ እንደሚጀመር ቢነገርም፣ ስለ ፈቃድ አሰጣጡ እና ስለ ጊዜ ሰሌዳው የተሟላ መረጃ እስካሁን የለም።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp gamoowwan garraamii mo'ichaa (triumphal arch) miira 250 dheeratu ijaaruuf qophaa'an, lafa meeshaalee waraanaa fi buufata waraanaa ta'ee akka tajaajiluuf jijjiirama gochuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gamoowwan kun meeshaalee waraanaa keessatti akka kuufamuufi, akkasumas lafa snayiperootaa fi droonota itti fayyadaman ta'ee akka tajaajilu himaniiru. Ijaarsi kun Arliingitaniin cinaatti akka eegalamu kan yaadame ta'us, hayyama fi yeroo ijaarsaa irratti odeeffannoon guutuun hanga ammaa hin jiru.

title: Hundreds protest in Tunisia for release of jailed Gaza flotilla activists
english: Hundreds of protesters gathered in Tunis to call for the release of four activists associated with the Global Sumud Flotilla. These individuals have been held in detention since March due to accusations regarding financial irregularities connected to an aid mission to Gaza. The demonstrators are urging authorities to free the activists who were involved in the effort to deliver humanitarian supplies.
amharic: በቱኒዚያ ዋና ከተማ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የግሎባል ሱሙድ ፍሎቲላ አክቲቪስቶች እንዲለቀቁ በመጠየቅ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። አራቱ ግለሰቦች ወደ ጋዛ እርዳታ ለማድረስ በተደረገ ጥረት ላይ የገንዘብ ብልሹ አሠራር ፈጽመዋል በሚል ከመጋቢት ወር ጀምሮ በእስር ላይ ይገኛሉ። ሰልፈኞቹ እነዚህን የሰብዓዊ እርዳታ አቅራቢ አክቲቪስቶች መንግሥት በአስቸኳይ እንዲፈታ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Tuniziyaatti namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa’aman miseensota 'Global Sumud Flotilla' afran hidhaman akka gadhiifaman gaafachuun hiriira bahaniiru. Hiriirtonni kunneen namoota gargaarsa namoomaa geessuuf socho’aa turan kun hatattamaan akka hiikaman mootummaa gaafachaa jiru.

title: Humanoid robots fight in cage match in Shanghai
english: In Shanghai, AI-driven humanoid robots recently competed in a unique cage fighting event. Organized by the Ultimate Robot Knock-out Legend league, the match showcased the physical capabilities of advanced machines in a combat setting. This event highlights the growing intersection of robotics technology and competitive entertainment.
amharic: በሻንጋይ ከተማ በሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት የሚሰሩ ሂውማኖይድ ሮቦቶች በአይነቱ ልዩ የሆነ የካጅ ጦርነት አድርገዋል። የኡልቲሜት ሮቦት ኖክ-አውት ሌጀንድ ሊግ ባዘጋጀው በዚህ ውድድር፣ ሮቦቶቹ በተዘጋ ቦታ ውስጥ አካላዊ ጥንካሬያቸውን አሳይተዋል። ይህ ክስተት የሮቦቲክስ ቴክኖሎጂ እና የመዝናኛ ውድድሮች እየተቀራረቡ መምጣታቸውን ያሳያል።
oromo: Finfinnee Shanghai keessatti, roobonni nama fakkaatan kanneen 'Artificial Intelligence' fayyadamanii socho'an, dorgommii qabsoo kage keessatti wal lolaniiru. Dorgommiin kun kan qophaa'e liigii 'Ultimate Robot Knock-out Legend' jedhamuun yoo ta'u, dandeettii qaamaa roobonni kun qaban agarsiiseera. Taateen kun guddina teeknoolojii roobootiksii fi dorgommii bashannansiisaa walitti dhufeenya qabaachuu isaa mul'isa.

title: The pro-Israel censors are starting to lose
english: The recent removal of rapper Macklemore from Ed Sheeran's tour due to his pro-Palestine stance backfired, sparking a wave of support for his cause. Several other artists withdrew from the tour in protest, while ticket sales suffered significant losses. Ultimately, these events brought increased attention and financial aid to Palestinian humanitarian efforts, signaling a weakening in the ability to suppress pro-Palestine narratives.
amharic: ራፐር ማክልሞር ስለ ፍልስጤም ባነሳው አቋም ከኤድ ሺራን የኮንሰርት ጉብኝት መባረሩ ተቃውሞን በማስነሳት ይልቁንም ለጉዳዩ ትልቅ ትኩረት እንዲሰጥ አድርጓል። ሌሎች አርቲስቶች በድጋፍ ከጉብኝቱ በመውጣታቸው እና የቲኬት ዋጋ በመቀነሱ በስተመጨረሻ ለፍልስጤም ሰብዓዊ ድጋፍ የሚውል ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ እርዳታ እንዲሰበሰብ አስችሏል። ይህ ክስተት እስራኤልን የሚደግፉ አካላት በህዝብ ንግግር ላይ የነበራቸው ቁጥጥር እየተዳከመ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Raappaar Maaklemor waa'ee Filisxeem dubbachuu isaatiin tourii Ed Shiiraan irraa ari'amuun isaa, mormii guddaa fi deggarsa kana caalu kan fide ta'eera. Artistoonni biroon mormii isaanii ibsuuf tourii kana keessaa waan bahanif fi gatiin tikkeetii waan hir'ateef, kun xiyyeeffannoo fi gargaarsa maallaqaa gara Filisxeemitti akka darbu taasisera. Ta'een kun, namoonni yaada Filisxeem deggaran ukkaamsuuf yaalan ammas humna isaanii dhabbaa akka jiran agarsiisa.

title: Jews and Muslims lived together for centuries. Did Zionism tear them apart?
english: A recent podcast episode explores the historical relationship between Jewish and Muslim communities, noting that they coexisted peacefully for many centuries in various regions. The discussion highlights the perspective of the Neturei Karta, an Orthodox Jewish group that opposes Zionism on religious grounds. The program examines how the emergence of the modern Jewish state and Zionist ideology altered long-standing communal ties.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የፖድካስት ዝግጅት በይሁዲዎች እና በሙስሊሞች መካከል የነበረውን የረጅም ጊዜ ታሪካዊ ግንኙነት ይዳስሳል። አብዛኛውን ጊዜ እነዚህ ማህበረሰቦች በሰላም አብረው ይኖሩ እንደነበር ይገልጻል። ፕሮግራሙ የኒቱሬይ ካርታ የተባለውን ጽዮናዊነትን የሚቃወም የአይሁድ ቡድን አቋም በመመልከት፣ የዘመናዊው እስራኤል መንግሥት መመስረት በነዚህ ማህበረሰቦች መካከል የነበረውን ግንኙነት እንዴት እንደቀየረው ያነሳል።
oromo: Qophiin podkastii tokko hariiroo seenaa qabeessa kan yihuudotaa fi muslimoota gidduu ture kan qoratu yoo ta'u, jaarraa hedduuf nagaan waliin jiraachaa turuu isaanii ibsa. Sagantaan kun garee 'Neturei Karta' jedhamuu fi yaada Siyonizimii morman irratti xiyyeeffata. Akkasumas, hundeeffamni mootummaa Israa'el hariiroo ummattoota kanaa irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka uume ni sakatta'a.

title: What’s behind Iranian authorities’ push for a mass mobilisation campaign?
english: Iranian authorities have launched a nationwide recruitment campaign called 'Janfada' to train and arm civilian volunteers as part of the IRGC's Basij militia. The movement, which displays military weaponry on public banners, aims to bolster state security amid ongoing regional tensions with the United States and Israel. While officials claim high participation numbers, the initiative has drawn skepticism and international concern regarding its true scale and intent.
amharic: የኢራን መንግሥት 'ጃንፋዳ' የተባለ ሀገራዊ የቅስቀሳ ዘመቻ የጀመረ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ሲቪል ፈቃደኞችን በመመልመል እና በማስታጠቅ ከኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኞች (IRGC) የባሲጅ ሚሊሻ ጋር እንዲቀላቀሉ ያደርጋል። ይህ እንቅስቃሴ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና ከእስራኤል ጋር ባለው ውጥረት መካከል የመንግሥትን ደህንነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። ባለስልጣናት ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያለው ህዝብ እንደተመዘገበ ቢናገሩም፣ ዘመቻው በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ጥርጣሬን እና ስጋትን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan fedhii uummataa itti fayyadamee 'Janfada' jedhamuun sochii waraanaa irratti hirmaannaa uummataa babal'isuuf yaalii jalqabeera. Sochii kanaan namoonni fedhii qaban akka leenjifamanii fi meeshaalee waraanaa hidhatanii miseensa 'Basij' kan humna waraana IRGC ta'an akka ta'an taasifamaa jira. Mootummaan Iraan kun kan godhame waraana Amerikaa fi Israa'el waliin jiruun wal-qabatee nageenya biyyattii cimsuuf akka ta'e ibseera, haa ta'u malee lakkoofsi namoota hirmaachuu jedhame kun addunyaa irratti gaaffii guddaa kaaseera.

title: Iran military warns middle eastern nations 'complicit' if US resumes attacks from American bases
english: The Iranian military has cautioned neighboring countries that they will be held responsible if they allow the United States to launch attacks against Iran from their territories. This warning follows increasing regional tensions, particularly involving Houthi activities targeting Saudi Arabia. Iran is effectively demanding that regional powers prevent their military infrastructure from being used in any potential American offensive.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ ኃይል በአካባቢው ያሉ ሀገራት አሜሪካ ከግዛታቸው ሆና በኢራን ላይ ጥቃት እንድትፈጽም ከፈቀዱ ተጠያቂ እንደሚሆኑ አስጠንቅቋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የመጣው በየመን የሚገኙ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ የሚያደርሱት ጥቃት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ነው። ኢራን ጎረቤት ሀገራት የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መሠረቶች ለእሷ ጥቃት እንዳይውሉ እንዲያደርጉ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Iraan, biyyoonni ollaa akkaataa itti Amerikaan buufata isaanii fayyadamtee Iraan irratti haleellaa raawwattu yoo heyyamte, isaanis akka hirmaataa lolaatti akka ilaalaman akeekkachiiseera. Akeekkachiisni kun kan dhufe waraanni Huthotaa Saudii Arabiyaa irratti haleellaa jabeessuun isaa fi naannichatti wal dhabdeen dabaluu isaa hordofee dha. Iraan biyyoonni naannichaa buufata waraanaa isaanii haleellaa Amerikaa irratti akka hin oolchineef gaaffii dhiheessiteetti.

title: Israeli president pardons soldier convicted for killing wounded Palestinian
english: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has granted a pardon to Elor Azaria, a former soldier previously convicted of killing a wounded Palestinian man in 2016. This decision effectively clears Azaria’s criminal record, a move justified by the President as an act of reconciliation during the holiday season. The pardon has been controversial, as it went against the explicit recommendation of the Israeli military leadership, who argued that the former soldier failed to show genuine remorse for his actions.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ፕሬዚዳንት አይዛክ ሄርዞግ እ.ኤ.አ በ2016 ቆስሎ የነበረ ፍልስጤማዊን በመግደል ወንጀል ተፈርዶበት የነበረውን የቀድሞ ወታደር ኤሎር አዛሪያን ይቅርታ አድርገውለታል። ይህ ውሳኔ የአዛሪያን የወንጀል መዝገብ ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚያጠፋ ሲሆን፣ ፕሬዚዳንቱ ውሳኔውን የወሰኑት እንደ እርቅ ምልክት አድርገው ነው። ሆኖም ይህ ውሳኔ የቀድሞው ወታደር ለፈጸመው ድርጊት ጥልቅ መጸጸት አላሳየም በማለት የተቃወሙትን የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ አመራሮች ምክር የጣሰ በመሆኑ በሀገሪቱ ውዝግብ አስነሳል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Israa'el Isaak Herzoog loltuu duraanii Elor Azariyaa kan bara 2016 nama Falasxiin madaa'e tokko ajjeeseef himatamee tureef dhiifama godhaniiru. Murteen kun seenaa yakka Azariyaa guutummaatti kan haqee dha; pirezedantichis tarkaanfichaa haala araaraatiin kan fudhatan ta'uu ibsaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, ajajaan waraana Israa'el loltuun kun gocha isaa irratti gaabbiin dhugaa mul'isuu dhabuu isaa himuun dhiifamichi akka hin godhamne gorsa kennanii turan; kanaafuu murteen pirezedantichaa mormii cimaa uumeera.

title: Qatar condemns Houthi attacks on Riyadh and civilian infrastructure in Yemen
english: Qatar has officially denounced recent Houthi missile strikes targeting Saudi Arabia’s capital and various civilian locations. The Qatari government labeled these actions as illegal violations of sovereignty and international norms. Expressing full support for Saudi security measures, Qatar demanded an immediate end to all attacks against non-military targets.
amharic: ኳታር በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ እና ሌሎች የሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ የተፈጸሙትን የሁቲ ሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች በይፋ አውግዛለች። የኳታር የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት እና ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥሱ መሆናቸውን ገልጿል። ኳታር ለሳውዲ አረቢያ ደህንነት ያላትን ድጋፍ በማረጋገጥ፣ በሲቪሎች ላይ የሚደርሱ ጥቃቶች በአስቸኳይ እንዲቆሙ ጥሪ አቅርባለች።
oromo: Qatar haleellaa gammoojjii (missaayila) gareen Huutii magaalaa Riyaadifi naannolee biroo irratti raawwate balaaleffatteetti. Mootummaan Qatar haleellaan kun kabaja biyyaalessaa fi seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsu akka ta'e ibseera. Qatar nageenya Saudii Arabiyaaf deggarsa guutuu qabdu mirkaneessuun, haleellaan siviilota irratti raawwatamu hatattamaan akka dhaabbatu gaafatteetti.

title: Israeli minister Ben Gvir enters Al-Aqsa courtyard again amid tensions
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir visited the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound in East Jerusalem under police protection this Sunday. This marks his second visit in recent weeks, during which he reportedly conducted prohibited prayers at the site. These actions have sparked controversy as they violate the established agreement that limits non-Muslim activities to visits only, excluding prayer.
amharic: የእስራኤል የብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር በእስራኤል ኃይሎች ታጅበው በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም ወደሚገኘው የአል-አቅሳ መስጊድ ግቢ ገብተዋል። በቅርብ ሳምንታት ውስጥ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ በግቢው የታዩት ሚኒስትሩ፣ በቦታው ላይ የሃይማኖት ጸሎት ማድረጋቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህ ድርጊት ሙስሊም ያልሆኑ ሰዎች በቦታው ላይ ጸሎት እንዳያደርጉ የሚከለክለውን የረጅም ጊዜ ስምምነት የሚጥስ በመሆኑ ውዝግብ አስነሳ።
oromo: Ministeerri nageenya biyyoolessaa Israa'el Itamar Ben Gviir humnoota nageenyaatiin eegamaa gara dirree masjiida Al-Aqsa kan magaalaa Yerusaalem bahaa jiru tokko seenaniiru. Kun torbanoota darban keessa yeroo lammaffaadhaaf gara dirree sanaa kan seenan yoo ta'u, achittis kadhannaa dhoorkaa ta'e raawwachuun isaanii gabaafameera. Gochi kun namoonni muslima hin taane bakka sanatti akka hin kadhanne seerota durii irraa ture kan cabsu waan ta'eef, mormii guddaa kaaseera.
